sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य।।
caption:
Chapter 11, Verse 35

Sañjaya describes Arjuna’s state. ‘etac chrutvā vacanaṁ keśavasya’ (Hearing these words of Keśava). ‘kṛtāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī’ (Arjuna, the wearer of the crown, trembling and with folded hands). ‘namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṁ’ (Offered obeisances again and again and spoke to Kṛṣṇa). ‘sa-gadgadaṁ bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya’ (In a faltering voice, very fearful). Arjuna is totally broken. The arrogance of the warrior is gone; the casual friendship is gone. He is ‘Vepamanah’ (trembling) and ‘Bhita-bhitah’ (fearful). He realizes he has been joking with the Fire of Death.
